coordinate_convention.unit: Unity/NGUI native UI units. Not screenshot pixels.
coordinate_convention.card_root_space: A serialized descendant transform flattened relative to the card root. Root is normalized to identity. This is not the final Unity scene world space.
coordinate_convention.bounds_order: [left,bottom,right,top] from pivot and widget; excludes visual trim, shader effects, runtime resize/crop and clipping.
coordinate_convention.calculation: child_position = parent_position + parent_scale * local_position; child_scale = parent_scale * local_scale. All card node rotations were checked to be identity.
coordinate_convention.runtime_caveat: Serialized active/enabled are not authoritative runtime display states; scripts, loaded assets and screen scaling were not executed.

ordinary_columns.scene_observation: level17: SupportSelectMenu y=-30; ListViewManager 0; ScrollView y=25; Grid 0 and ListItemSeed 0. Scene UIRoot scale ~1/288 is world conversion, not a pixel scale. The prefab attachment/runtime FSOffset are not established by these Transform nodes alone.

verified_conclusions: Main and append roots have identical transforms in both cards; they are siblings, not vertical rows. Their SkillIconSprite children also coincide exactly.
Ordinary has one equipment slot; grand has three. Grand centers relative card root: (0,-32), (0,-80), (0,-128).
Grand slot spacing is 48 root units; scale .706 belongs to each slot and scales its contents, not the slot-center translations in EquipRoot.
Grand card class label has nested scale .51 * 1.18 = .6018.
Portrait evidence is NarrowFigure/Body UITexture, not a separately located avatar/face; no face crop or facial landmark can be inferred.
NP hierarchy is under SkillLevelTreasureDeviceBase/TreasureDeviceLevelBase, not a standalone card-bottom badge.
Grand menu in level29 has no serialized child slots; full scene slot count, placement, page spacing and parent card scale are unknown.
limits: Grand frame/background/class/blank-equipment names exist in JSON, but this audit does not supply their missing runtime PNG textures.
UIMeshSprite equipment texture geometry is not decoded in the provided JSON. Slot size is backed by UIWidget/NoneEquipSprite, not an independent decoded equipment-mesh rectangle.
UILabel widget dimensions are serialized layout boxes and are not font size or final rendered text widths.
Do not treat same-position active prefab objects as proof they are simultaneously visible at runtime.
Do not claim runtime toggle logic was executed. Only overlapping serialized slots and presence of SwitchUIWidgetComponent are established.
